meaning: All items are Rust acceptance obligations, not completed work. Upstream evidence is separate.

items.requirement: Record selected product, renderer, runtime and theme pins for every golden; reject mixed-version captures.
Inventory actual Rust bridge/component APIs and map them to the capability table; no guessed existing/missing statuses.
Capture the real upstream and Rust production components using identical deterministic fixture data.
Compare text, positions, styles, clipping, cursor and hit targets; text-only equality is insufficient.
Preserve wide-cell continuation and grapheme semantics in canonical frame serialization.
Record exact baseline terminal/font environment for pixel captures and isolate terminal-specific cases.
Require event traces as well as frames for navigation, queue/steer, permissions, forms and input submission.
Freeze time and use explicit checkpoints for every motion effect and deadline.
Await asynchronous syntax completion; do not bless blank transient code blocks as goldens.
Exercise streaming→complete, complete→final-content, resync, backfill and stale async-result orders.
Preserve node identity during in-place updates; preserve logical IDs, saved group expansion and semantic scroll anchors across keyed session remounts and tab switches.

Match upstream keymap scope, priority and reachability in popups, docks, modals and focused side panels; suppress background actions only where upstream suppresses them, while retaining intentionally global commands.
Verify there are no duplicate sends or unintended tool actions from pointer release/drag selection.
Test narrow/short terminals and every exact predicate boundary, not only one 160-column screenshot.
Resolve full light/dark/transparent/stateful theme values, preserving hue provenance.
Separate baseline, optional configuration, experimental design and approved extension fixtures.
Keep selected-pin bugs and deliberate fixes explicit; do not silently merge v2.2.0 behavior.
Verify teardown cancels timers, rejects late workers, releases resources once and restores terminal state.
Use mounted/rendered work counts for large transcript/diff bounds; preserve visible geometry.
Run negative controls that prove one-cell, color, threshold and duplicate-action regressions fail.
Preserve existing semantic tests; investigate source disagreements before changing expected output.
Attach source/fixture hashes, exact test commands, failures and installed captures to the final Rust SHA.
Keep all Rust parity statuses unverified until executed against the real integrated Rust build.
Complete bridge-source inspection after correcting the duplicate Secure Tunnel ID routing problem.
Root fills terminal at 80×24,120×40,160×48,200×60 without unintended overflow.
Width 43/44 switches route horizontal inset 1→2; prompt/footer remain within viewport.
Default vertical rail at 105→horizontal,106→vertical; width 60 rail at 123→horizontal,124→vertical.
Resizing rail respects 5/72/min-content 44; compact transition exactly 11/12.
Width 68/69 with width 5 rail crosses vertical eligibility correctly.
No-left-rail width 120 has no auto sidebar;121 shows fixed 42 sidebar.
Width 162/163 with default vertical rail crosses auto-right-sidebar threshold.
Manual narrow sidebar overlays rather than shrinks transcript; Escape/Ctrl+C closes.
Child session suppresses information sidebar, including manually requested state.
Panel width 107/108 switches fullscreen/docked; tabs hide only while panel full screen.
Sidebar/terminal/plugin panel precedence matches source; one right pane at a time.
Pane focus guard cannot pass Enter/click into a permission prompt; transcript wheel remains usable.
Resize handle 2-cell target,1-cell highlight, drag beyond bounds, release persistence, double-click reset 300 ms.
Transcript and sidebar scroll independently; title and footer remain pinned.
One reserved row below transcript remains present when jump action is absent.
Scrollbar show/hide reserves expected cells; sidebar absolute scrollbar does not reflow headings.
Switching tabs/restoring after reflow preserves semantic anchor and screen Y; child anchor independent.
Home prompt max-width 75, logo spacing, balanced spacers and footer gates match at short/wide sizes.
Home global form disables prompt and appears at expected bottom inset/z-order.
Width 44/64/80 and height 13/14/15/16 correctly gate home footer/actions/version/padding.
Port all adaptive layout numerical examples and sticky overflow-window tests.
Idle plus consumes 3 cells; active draft replaces it without duplication.
Status/number switches never shift title start cell; include 100+ tabs to grow number width.
Busy→permission/question uses !/? and pauses busy spinner; numbers mode stays numeric.
Root status includes child busy/attention, excludes child-only unread; permission outranks question.
Background user enqueue increments flash even when already busy; synthetic parked entries don't mark busy.
Selected/hovered/dragged/unread/error/renaming colors and text attributes match.
Four-cell title fade and grapheme-aware width handle CJK, emoji ZWJ, combining accents, Tamil, and long paths.
Marquee waits 600 ms, advances 80 ms, stops after one cycle, resets on leave/fit.
Expanded entries 2 rows+gap 1; compact entries 1+gap 1; detail project/worktree rules match.
5-column compact golden: search row 1, items 3/5/7, plus 9, transcript column 5; half-block colors correct.
Compact tooltip 4 rows/max 54 cols, clamp on bottom edge, hide while dragging/menu.
Click/middle-close/right-menu/hover-close each match; hidden close cell never closes.
Transcript selection release over plus/search/close does not trigger action.
Drag reorder preview persists once and suppresses synthetic release activation.
Horizontal repeated close retains pointer's close cell through overflow change; leave/5s releases.
Active tab reveal happens after new layout and respects viewport during long vertical lists.
Context menu placement, entries, hover, outside dismissal and up-to 10 recent list match.
Close-active chooses MRU then right/left fallback; close-background keeps active; reopen original position.
Tab order/scope survive restart; recent-closed/history remain in-memory by design.
Focus-confirmed view acknowledgement and retry 250 ms→5s reproduce unread transition.
Async/shared-store mutations cannot resurrect a closed tab or alternate title fallbacks.
All default and customized tab/sidebar/focus shortcuts dispatch same commands.
Reduced-animation state preserves statuses/attention and dims pending title; deterministic clock captures full-motion phases.
Width 42, outer padding 2/2/1/1, title inset, body gap 1, pinned footer and absolute scrollbar match.
Visible default section order Context→Limit→MCP→Todo; hidden contributions leave no artificial blank section.
No usage/no cost hides Context; cost-only, tokens-only, unknown-model-limit, revert and cached-token cases match.
Usage percentage includes correct five token classes and uses last eligible assistant's model.
Limit hidden/unlimited/positive/reached/out states and text colors match separately from context.
MCP 0/1/2/3 servers trigger correct section/disclosure behavior; collapsed active/error counts correct.
MCP pending/connected/disabled/failed/needs_auth map to exact label/dot/name/status styles.
Long MCP name truncates before fixed status; row click selects server and failed details.
MCP heading expanded state persists; no invented row hover treatment.
Todo takes latest completed list before revert, wraps body, renders markers/styles and remaining count.
MCP/Todo <=2 remain visible even if persisted collapsed from an earlier larger list.
Onboarding at height 21/22, integrations loading/connected/disconnected, dismissed/undismissed matches.
Footer path max 38, branch suffix, UNIX/Windows/UNC/CJK/emoji basename truncation matches.
Footer hover/copy/open/workspaces actions match; text selection prevents opening menu.
LSP/changed-files additions are labeled extension fixtures, never silently counted as project-pinned v2 default parity.

items.requirement: Default medium transcript groups thoughts and exploration, leaves questions standalone, and preserves one-row outer spacing without double gaps in nested groups.
Low/medium/high and thinking show/hide reproduce correct default disclosures; changing one session does not corrupt another session's saved expansion.
Pending permission tool remains visible outside collapsed groups; a same part/call ID reused in another message does not hide the wrong row.
Expand/collapse, backfill, reconnect, tab switch, and width resize preserve stable anchors, selected content, and expansion. No jump to the transcript bottom when the user is reading history.
User card content, one-cell `┃` border, agent/pending border colors, padding, hover transform, chips, and image gap match cell-for-cell.
Text drag selection never opens message actions, group disclosure, tool details, or a child session on mouse-up.
Message action menu correctly restores prompt on revert, copies message text, forks by current message ID, and tolerates a resync while open.
Footer behavior at widths 27/28/35/36 is correct; agent/model/duration/TPS/interrupted states match.

Duration and throughput cover legacy input boundaries and marker-era turns with steers, model switches, missing stream timestamps, and an absent assistant anchor; tool duration is excluded from throughput.
Queue dock, pending-steer actions, revert card, location/model/agent notices, and child completion notices match in each state.
Paragraphs, headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, blockquotes, ordered/unordered lists, nested lists, links, rules, fences, and grid tables match upstream cells and colors.
Unfinished fence, unfinished inline formatting, split Unicode/grapheme input, blank/whitespace chunks, and completion arriving before/after final content preserve all text.
Both final-content/completion event orders finish a streamed fence with exactly its complete content and one block; no stale initial text and no duplicate block.
Rendered/source toggle reproduces concealment and preserves selection/scroll anchors. Reflow on narrow width does not corrupt code/table geometry.
Theme switch recolors existing syntax and Markdown without losing text; reasoning uses muted foreground while retaining noncolor syntax attributes.
Valid bold first-block thinking titles become summary metadata; ordinary initial bold prose does not. Redacted-only reasoning renders nothing.
Unrelated plugin toggle preserves Markdown block identity; changed/removed fence handler updates existing blocks.
Each supported Mermaid kind, wide horizontal drag, streaming partial syntax, invalid syntax, oversized canvas, and fallback preserve geometry and source.
LaTeX/math fences retain last good partial layout only when source extends it; unsupported syntax falls back; long formulas scroll horizontally and do not steal vertical transcript scroll.
All 14 specialized names plus unknown/plugin/MCP fallback dispatch correctly; legacy names map to shell/subagent/patch.
Streaming/running/completed/error/denied/permission-needed each have correct label, icon, spinner, color, strikethrough, and click behavior.
Wrapped labels start after fixed 2-cell icon column; expanded error text aligns to the label; Background badge wraps as one padded item at narrow widths.
Primitive generic arguments flatten to one line; nested JSON is only in expanded view; ANSI output does not leak escape sequences.
Shell command/output share a 10-line collapsed budget; command max 2 visual rows; output tail and earlier-line label stay correct for wide glyphs and multiline commands.
Background shell collapses without needless polling, live expansion updates at the correct cadence, completion drains output, large output is bounded, moved sessions retain original process location.
New subagent, continued subagent, running child after tool completion, completed, error, cancelled, and detached Background badge all match without invented percentage progress.
Subagent explicit model override and variant display match; missing override adds no model label; click follows the correct child session.
Execute root and metadata child rows update independently; metadata runtime error changes root color even when transport state is completed.
Execute child expansion reveals structured arguments; root/details action is distinct; success output stays out of inline preview; runtime errors show exactly the bounded preview.
Execute dialog live status, TypeScript/JSON syntax, matching gutters, wrapped continuation line numbers, output/logs, copy actions, and scroll keys match.
Read range and loaded-instruction rows, Glob/Grep counts, WebFetch/Search/provider names, skill names, todos, and question-result blocks match.
Inline auto split at content widths 120/121; permission auto split at terminal widths 120/121; dedicated viewer split availability at patch-pane widths 99/100.
Add/edit/delete/move, multiple hunks, long paths, 3-to-4-digit line numbers, wrap/source mode, and syntax colors align with all diff background/gutter roles.
Added-file virtualization only in eligible scroll-aware context; crossing 3,000 lines/chunk boundaries preserves source highlighting and exact placeholder heights.
Deleted-file count and applied-resource fallback appear without fabricated diff content; malformed wire metadata is filtered without a crash.
Only valid severity-1 diagnostics render, maximum 3, with normalized path and 1-based positions.
Image preview off/on, 0/1/3/4 images, failed image, short/tall terminals, user/tool previews, and gallery click all match, including no click bubbling.
Permission once/always/reject variants; missing save rules omit always; changing selected option changes the body; nested rejection reason is correctly scoped.
Permission width 79/80, normal/fullscreen, Escape minimize/reject, ctrl-c clear/cancel, and edit-diff body preserve geometry and focus.
Text/number/integer/boolean/single/multi/external/conditional/default fields, validation, review, and draft restoration behave identically.
Narrow field fallback replaces tabs at the exact fit boundary; 24-character tab labels, checkbox width 4, description insets 3/7, and textarea height 1–6 are verified.
Paste into selected custom choice opens editing without submit; paste into active editor inserts at cursor; burst typing is not lost; up leaves the editor only from first visual line.
Space toggles multiselect but not single choice; optional empty multiselect omits the answer; validation waits until the matching submit point.
External URL is not acknowledged by merely opening/copying; review errors/progress count external acknowledgement; wrapped review only offers scroll when needed.
Terminal/stale/revalidation-failed forms restore composer focus and drafts; keyboard scope does not leak actions into the underlying transcript.
Spinner clock at 0/79/80/160 ms, animations off, visibility/culling, frame-list change, destroy, and parent background composition match.
Compaction queued/running/completed/provider-native/failed/cancelled and summary streaming match; request usage is not mislabeled as new context size.
Retry countdown with zero/past/future deadline, ordinary error, interruption, free limit, and optional token diagnostics match.
Background hint is absent before 3 seconds and appears for the same eligible long-running work, then disappears on completion/replacement.
Medium/large/xlarge width, terminal−2 cap, quarter-height and centered placements match at odd/even sizes.
Shared shell, layout gaps, list row padding, footer bands and 59/60-column responsive behavior match both experiment states.
Modal replacement does not remount on reactive updates; close restores only a surviving original focus target.
